split_policy.primary_axis: tooling/e2e audit contract behavior before fixture directory label, summary JSON, snapshot JSON, extractor log, expected status file, hard-fail drift row, old-mode label, shim label, fallback label, compatibility label, or migration label
split_policy.positive_rule: open blocker audit contract positives are limited to the hand-authored happy audit-runner contract owned by the e2e/tooling owner; parser, sema, lowering, IR, and runtime phases get no positive compiler behavior from this fixture family
split_policy.canonical_rejection_rule: old-mode audit contracts, compatibility-shaped contract rows, shim/fallback rows, generated-only rows, evidence-log rows, migration-only rows, wrapper-only rows, runner-only rows, and directory-label-only claims are non-positive rejection or provenance evidence
split_policy.strict_error_rule: hard_fail_* contract drift scenarios own fail-closed strict errors for log contract drift, snapshot parity key order drift, status/exit mismatch, and summary schema drift
split_policy.provenance_rule: summary JSON, snapshot JSON, extractor logs, expected stderr, expected exit-code, expected final-status, expected final-exit-code, runner argv, source labels, generated-at labels, path labels, and byte-count rows are fixture provenance unless the e2e/tooling owner claims the scenario boundary
split_policy.retired_surface_rule: old-mode audit, compatibility audit, shim audit, fallback audit, generated-only audit, evidence-log audit, migration-only audit, wrapper-only audit, runner-only success, workflow-label-only success, and generated/report rows promoted as support are canonical rejection, strict-error, absent-support, or provenance-only evidence
